MagLiB™ printed circuit board Enables higher charging rates while helping reduce the dendrite risks typically associated with faster charging. Bringing order to battery charging MagLiB™ combines embedded magnetic PCBs with Aeon™, Gaussion's control chip, adaptive firmware and learning database, to coordinate magnetic-field patterns across the battery pack. By guiding ion movement and reducing resistance at the particle level, the system helps batteries charge faster, generate less heat and perform more smoothly — supporting longer lifetime without requiring a redesign of the cell.
